what: Refusal cases, failures in the middle of a real switch, and a second profile, on a clean stock Windows Hermes install with two real Codex accounts.
machine: Hyper-V test machine switcher-test, Windows 11 Pro 25H2 build 26200; Hermes v0.21.5+3840.g9a0a162 (upstream 9a0a1625) installed by a normal signed-in user with the official source script
method: Each case puts the machine into one bad condition, asks the installed plugin for status and preflight through Hermes Desktop's own backend, forces a switch request anyway, and compares before and after: account order, a one-way mark of every login, the settings file, and the Desktop, backend and gateway process ids. The condition is always undone; a login field is put back only if Hermes has not changed it in the meantime. Scripts: test-vm/vm-refusal.py, test-vm/vm-failure.py, test-vm/vm-billing-proof.py. Raw results: C:/VMs/switcher-test/results/.

refusals_on_rc3_development_build.case: The settings name an email that matches no login
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.status_and_preflight: HTTP 409, 'Codex account identity is missing, duplicated, or unrecognized.'
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.forced_switch: accepted, failed after 8.0 s with the same message, before anything was closed
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.changed_afterwards: rc.4 names the login's email and says it is not in the settings

refusals_on_rc3_development_build.case: OpenAI rejects the target login (its signature was altered, as a revoked login would be)
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.status_and_preflight: HTTP 200, no blocker: the idle check does not ask OpenAI
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.forced_switch: accepted, failed after 8.0 s during checking with 'Could not confirm the selected Codex account with OpenAI.', before anything was closed

refusals_on_rc3_development_build.case: The target login's access token has expired
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.what_happened: Hermes renewed the login with OpenAI by itself 5 seconds later (new token issued 17:37:28). The forced switch, requested after the refusal, then found a valid login and completed a real, verified switch in 43.7 s.
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.verdict: REFUSED WHILE EXPIRED, then allowed once Hermes had renewed the login. Not a standing refusal.
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.side_effect: The Gmail login on the test machine was renewed, so the restore points taken before 17:37 hold an older copy of it.
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.changed_afterwards: rc.4 says which login expired and that Hermes normally renews it by itself

refusals_on_rc3_development_build.case: The selected login is marked dead
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.status: selected gmail, effective personal, warning 'hermes: Gmail login is dead, so Codex is billing Personal. Sign Gmail in again.'
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.real_request_while_dead: answered; every request on the wire carried the Personal login, as the warning said
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.verdict: PASS: the warning names the account that really pays
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.changed_afterwards: rc.4 names the first profile 'default' instead of its folder name

refusals_on_rc3_development_build.case: A conversation is running in Hermes Desktop
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.dialog: 'Switch blocked: default: A conversation is running, initializing, or waiting for input.' (screenshot busy-dialog-174340.png)
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.forced_switch: accepted, failed after 9.1 s with the same message, before anything was closed; the conversation kept running
refusals_on_rc3_development_build.running_chat_login: the plugin's per-backend state reported the running chat holding the Gmail login, the selected one

failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.case: The plugin's settings file changes while Hermes is closed
failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.build: rc.3 development build, repeated on rc.4
failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.result: failed; previous account order restored; Desktop and gateway reopened as new processes; no lock or drain marker left; order, logins and settings unchanged
failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.message_rc4: 'Account-switch settings changed during this operation; account writes refused.'

failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.case: The login store cannot be written while Hermes is closed (made read-only)
failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.build: rc.3 development build, repeated on rc.4
failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.result: failed during applying; the restore could not be written either and the receipt says so ('restore_failed; profile stores may disagree'); Desktop and gateway reopened; nothing had been changed; no lock or drain marker left
failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.changed_afterwards: the message now names the stage and says the previous order could not be written back (covered by a unit test; not repeated on the machine after that wording change)

failures_in_the_middle_of_a_switch.case: The switch worker is ended while Hermes is closed (a crash or a power cut)

build_rc3.after_reopening_desktop_by_hand: status and preflight said 'An account switch is already in progress.' with no way out from the interface; the installer refused as well
build_rc3.verdict: FAIL: a dead end for the user

build_rc4.after_reopening_desktop_by_hand: the lock and the plugin's drain marker were removed; the receipt reads 'The last account switch was interrupted during restarting, after Hermes had been closed. Check which account is selected before switching again. The Hermes gateway is not running; start it again.'; preflight clear
build_rc4.then: gateway started with Hermes's own scheduled task; a real switch completed in 37.6 s
build_rc4.how_rc4_was_installed_over_the_leftovers: the abandoned lock was set aside for the installer and put back byte for byte with its old date, by the test's operator

second_profile_on_rc4_development_build.profile: 'work', created with 'hermes profile create work'; it holds no Codex logins of its own
second_profile_on_rc4_development_build.finding: On this Hermes a profile without its own Codex logins uses the first profile's logins.
second_profile_on_rc4_development_build.before_enabling: preflight blocked: 'work: Account Switcher backend is not enabled.'; 'hermes -p work plugins enable codex-account-switch' refused with 'No plugin named codex-account-switch' until the plugin was installed into the profile's own folder
second_profile_on_rc4_development_build.after_installing_into_the_profile_and_en: preflight clear; switch personal to gmail complete in 39.6 s

requests_after_the_switch.work: every request carried the Gmail login
requests_after_the_switch.default: every request carried the Gmail login

requests_before_the_switch.work: every request carried the Personal login, the one then selected

second_profile_on_rc4_development_build.changed_afterwards: the blocker now gives the two steps and the exact command

not_answered_by_these_runs: A profile that holds its own Codex logins, on stock Hermes (it needs its own sign-ins by the accounts' owner).
A worker ended during applying, with stores half changed (needs more than one store).
seen_but_not_this_plugin: Hermes logs 'Group Chat worker failed to start' with an import deadlock at some gateway starts (16:05 and 17:09).
Right after Desktop reopens, preflight can report a conversation 'initializing' for a few seconds while Desktop restores its last session.
